description: Crown of Revelation Sanctified Item Level 98 Binds when picked up Head Cloth 119 Armor +19 Stamina +20 Intellect Durability 60 / 60 Classes: Priest Requires Level 60 Equip: Improves your chance to get a critical strike by 2.0%. Equip: Increases damage done by Shadow spells and effects by up to 69. Equip: Increases the damage dealt by your damage over time spells by 2%. Raiments of Revelation (0/8) Crown of Revelation Mantle of Revelation Girdle of Revelation Pants of Revelation Boots of Revelation Wrists of Revelation Hands of Revelation Garb of Revelation (2) Set : Your Mind Flay and Mind Sear no longer lose duration from taking damage during their channel. In addition, they deal 10% increased damage per other periodic Shadow effect you have on the target, up to a maximum increase of 30%. (4) Set : Your Mind Blast deals 100% reduced threat, and gains 20% damage increase from each stack of Mind Spike on the target. (6) Set : Damage done by your Mind Flay now increases the longer you channel the spell. Each time it deals damage, subsequent damage will increase by 285000%. This resets on each new channel.
